# billyharness

> Fast solo-owner Go agent harness with gateway, TUI, Telegram adapter, JSONL
> replay, compact native tools, lazy MCP, and Codex/DeepSeek/Qwen/Kimi provider paths.
> Read AGENTS.md first. `docs/` is architecture-only; active implementation
> state lives in `loop-develop/current-todo`.

## Start Here

- [Agent instructions](AGENTS.md): project rules, verification, docs policy,
  and workflow routing.
- [README](README.md): project overview and basic usage.
- [Loop workflow](loop-develop/README.md): current/history TODO rules.

## Agent Rules

- [Agent rules index](.agents/rules/README.md): detailed read triggers.
- [Documentation rule](.agents/rules/documentation.md): how agents read, write,
  and verify documentation.

## Architecture Canon

- [Docs index](docs/README.md): architecture canon and ADR index -- the sole
  enumerated list; do not re-list docs here.

## Generated References

- [CLI reference](docs/generated/cli.md): generated top-level commands, aliases, summaries, and doctor check descriptors.
- [Commands reference](docs/generated/commands.md): generated shared actions, TUI slash/keybindings, Telegram aliases, and command registry composition.
- [Config reference](docs/generated/config.md): generated config keys, env aliases, defaults, provenance layers, and settings.json fields.
- [Protocol events reference](docs/generated/events.md): generated event envelope fields, event types, required IDs, payload names, event sources, and table-driven lifecycle rules.
- [Gateway API reference](docs/generated/gateway-api.md): generated HTTP routes, auth classes, and DTO names.
- [Package index](docs/generated/packages.md): generated package doc comments, direct internal imports, and reverse import edges.
- [Tool catalog](docs/generated/tools.md): generated native tool schemas, risk classes, parallel metadata, and MCP policy fields.

Regenerate generated references with `go run ./cmd/fast-agent-harness docsgen`.
Check committed freshness with `go run ./cmd/fast-agent-harness docsgen -check`;
`doctor -docs` compares live-binary registry fingerprints to generated
`source-hash` footers.

## Coverage Note

Generated references cover code-owned inventories, not all prose or operator
truth. Command-specific flags stay in each command's `FlagSet`; non-tableable
event lifecycle checks remain in `internal/eventlog` and architecture prose.
`ops/` has seed runbooks, while live unit files, environment, logs, and host
state still need production inspection before being treated as verified.

## Operations Runbooks

- [Operations index](ops/README.md): production and diagnostics runbook lane
  outside architecture docs.
- [Doctor and diagnostics](ops/doctor-and-diagnostics.md): doctor, config,
  gateway readiness, MCP, session diagnostic commands, and redacted exports.
- [Production services](ops/production-services.md): production entrypoint,
  service names, readiness checks, restart flow, and redaction cautions.
